title: Paywall and upgrade screen CRO: convert free users at the moment they've felt value
summary: Corey Haines's open-source "paywalls" marketing skill is a playbook for in-app upgrade moments. It covers when to trigger paywalls (feature gates, usage limits, trial expiry), what components a good screen needs, timing and frequency rules, and anti-patterns to avoid.

principles.text: Show the paywall only after the user has felt real value, right after the aha moment.
principles.quote: User should have experienced real value first

principles.text: Make the upgrade tangible: demonstrate and preview paid features rather than just describing them.
principles.quote: Demonstrate the value of paid features

principles.text: Respect the no: never trap users, keep free usage easy, and preserve trust for later conversion.
Write the headline around what the user gets, and make the CTA specific and value-oriented.
principles.quote: Headline** - Focus on what they get: "Unlock [Feature] to [Benefit]"

principles.text: Trigger at genuine limits: after the value moment but before frustration, never during onboarding or mid-flow.
Cap frequency: limit prompts per session and use cool-downs measured in days, not hours, after a dismissal.
